_README: This is the GENESIS config every node must agree on. 'founders' is the list of testnet founding addresses (each has run {op:'seal_founder'}); 'relay' is the default relay a downloaded node dials. ⚠️ Luca: the single address here is a PLACEHOLDER (the known founding wallet). Before distributing, replace the founders array with the addresses of the two SEALED testnet founder nodes from the July 9 smoke test (your desktop node + the Hetzner testnet-box node) — each prints its address on its {"type":"ready"} startup line. A wrong list means every friend's node shows members:0 and warns possible-fork. Entries must match M_ + 32 uppercase hex chars (the node refuses to start otherwise). This file is NOT secret (no private keys) and ships inside the download; it is NOT served by the relay, so a compromised relay cannot swap the founder set.
